punchline: Bass misjudged a body by 112 years, so he built a place to measure decay.
thirty_sec: William Bass once judged a body dead for under a year; it was a Confederate colonel killed in 1864. With no facility studying human decay, he and his students built one in Knoxville and received the first donated body in 1981.
question: Which of your estimates keeps missing, and what could you record to learn why?
key_contrast: A guess from experience versus a record kept every time.
